entries.text: # Handover: Saint-Aubin community clinic, nursing coordination
entries.label: Handover: Saint-Aubin community clinic, nursing coordination

entries.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients and runs 6 consultation rooms.
entries.label: The clinic serves #,### registered patients…

entries.text: Opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday.
entries.label: Opening hours are ##:## to ##:##…

entries.text: Twelve nurses work in three shifts, plus four administrative staff.

entries.text: The clinic has held its current accreditation since April 2022; it expires in April 2027 and renewal requires an audit of infection-control records.

entries.text: Attendance averages 180 consultations a day, with a peak of 310 during the January 2025 flu wave.
entries.label: Attendance averages ### consultations a day,…

entries.text: No-show rate is 9 percent, down from 14 percent after reminder texts were introduced in September 2024.

entries.text: In March 2024 a vaccine fridge failed overnight and 2,100 euros of stock was discarded; the fridge now has a networked temperature alarm checked every morning, and a paper log is kept as a backup because the alarm itself failed silently once.

entries.text: In November 2024 a patient record was updated by two nurses at the same time and the allergy field was overwritten; the record system now locks a record while it is open.

entries.text: A prescription may not be renewed without a consultation within the past twelve months, after an audit found 38 renewals beyond that limit.
